id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|a0: "{var:1}, welcome to the Grand Training Ground of Angri-La.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|13: "Here you can take on the Grand Trial of Martial Might, training in which you fight monsters in succession.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|51: "Here you can take on the Grand Trial of Martial Might, training in which you fight monsters in succession.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|27: "One is choosing the best party combination for the monsters you face.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|32: "The other is defeating monsters in few moves, meaning the total of everyone's actions in battle until the enemy falls.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|45: "If you use few moves, you'll receive a special reward, so do your best.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|60: "...Huh? How strange. This should be your first time taking the trial, {var:1}, yet there is a record of it.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|6c: "...Well, for a Hero like you, {var:1}, no strange occurrence would be surprising.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|75: "I'd normally have you begin from the start, but as a special case, let's continue from this record.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|84: "Which trial of the Grand Trial would you like to take on?
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|8b: "I'm sorry. It seems you don't have enough members to take the trial. Come back when your party has grown.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|9b: "Please choose the members who will take the trial.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|a1: "You don't have enough members for the trial. Please fill every slot.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|ac: "Is it all right to begin the trial with these members?
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|b6: "The final trial is conducted by Master Nima. If you fight poorly, he'll smack you with his spanking stick, so stay sharp!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|c7: "And I have good news for all of you.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|cc: "With the black sun revived, Master Nima has given permission, and I've prepared a trial harder than Trial Three!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|dd: "Clear Trial Three and the next trial will open, so please give it a try.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_train_msg.bxon|e9: "Come back whenever you'd like to take on the Grand Trial again.
